title: Figure 4: "Unfolding" the Ghost Interference experiment (ray diagrams)
description: Two-part ray diagram: (a) shows a "Pump" beam entering a crystal, with entangled photons split by a beam splitter (BS) toward detector D1 above slits and detector D2 with position axis x2; (b) shows the equivalent "unfolded" straight-through geometry with D1, slit points A/B and C/D, path lengths rC1, rD1, rA2, rB2 and distances z0, z1, z2. The caption reads "Figure 4. 'Unfolding' the Ghost Interference Experiment." Text explains why the coincidence requirement was needed to observe the two-slit pattern.
